أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
رحمه: May His mercy be upon him.
بوب: The chapter headings are as follows:
منها: Some of them are questions about Allah Almighty, and Sheikh al-Islam Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Taymiyyah, may Allah have mercy on him, answered them.
المصروع: The one who is overcome with fear or panic
يصرعه: He will be thrown into a state of convulsion or epilepsy.
تنحبس: She is held back or restrained
رضي: May Allāh be pleased with him/her/them.
وتفرغ: And he became free from occupation
يسترقى: He seeks magical protection or uses witchcraft
اختلف: There is a difference of opinion.
تعاد: He returned or she returned or they returned.
بركت؟: Blessed? Or have you attained blessings?
الخ: The preceding text in the book was:
للمصروع: For the one who faints or is overcome
توكله: I put my trust in Him
فالموسر: And he who is granted ease (in wealth)
يتلبس: He puts on or wraps himself in.
خطبهم: He delivered a sermon to them.
